output_document.summary: The Q3 2024 incident report documents that API consumers experienced 2-4 hour outages when the rate limit threshold was lowered from 1000 to 500 requests per minute without 72-hour advance notice. The postmortem identified three critical lessons for the webhooks feature: (1) all limit changes must require 72-hour advance notice to affected clients, (2) clients must have a documented escalation path for support issues, and (3) rate limit headers should be included in all API responses to provide transparency. These practices ensure clients have visibility into limits and sufficient time to adapt their integration when changes occur.
